flags.suggested: The pain ran from my left wrist, past my shoulder joint, all the way to my shoulder.

ko_def: 어떤 상태나 조건이 무엇이든 관계없이.
ko: 지수가 나를 어떻게 생각하는지는 아무래도 상관없었다.
en_current: Whatever Jisu thinks of me, it doesn't matter anyhow.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Past tense 상관없었다 mistranslated as present tense ("doesn't matter")
flags.suggested: Whatever Jisu thought of me, it didn't matter at all.

ko_def: 갚아야 할 것을 내주다.
ko: 민준이는 가게에서 제품을 고르고 나서 물건값을 물었다.
en_current: Minjun picked out a product in the store and then paid for it.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "recover" is the opposite of 물다 (pay/compensate what is owed)
flags.suggested: pay; repay; compensate; reimburse

ko_def: 겉으로 드러나지 않은, 속에 품고 있는 생각.
ko: 나는 새삼스레 내 일을 도와주겠다는 지수의 저의가 궁금했다.
en_current: I suddenly wondered about Jisu's ultimate motive for offering to help with my work.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 저의 means ulterior motive/hidden intention, not "ultimate motive"
flags.suggested: I suddenly wondered about Jisu's ulterior motive for offering to help with my work.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "ultimate motive" misrenders 저의 (hidden/ulterior intention)
flags.suggested: ulterior motive; hidden intention

gloss_current: An exclamation uttered at the end of a prayer, a hymnal song, or a sermon in Christianity in hope that it will be reali…
ko_def: 기독교에서, 기도나 찬송 또는 설교 끝에 그것이 이루어지기를 바란다는 뜻으로 하는 말.
ko: 저희의 기도를 들어주시옵소서, 아멘.
en_current: Hear our prayer, Lord, amen.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Adds vocative "Lord" not present in 저희의 기도를 들어주시옵소서, 아멘.
flags.suggested: Hear our prayer, amen.

ko_def: 수술이나 해부를 하기 위하여 수술용 칼을 잡음.
ko: 김 박사의 집도로 시체의 부검이 실시되었다.
en_current: The autopsy of the body was carried out under Dr. Kim's direction.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 집도 means personally performing the autopsy with a scalpel, not directing
flags.suggested: The autopsy of the body was performed by Dr. Kim.

ko_def: 피부색이 검은색 또는 갈색을 띤 인종에 속하는 사람.
ko: 나는 재즈와 같은 흑인 음악을 즐겨 듣는다.
en_current: I enjoy listening to Black music, such as jazz.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "Negroid" is outdated and offensive for 흑인
flags.suggested: Black person

ko_def: 군대에서, 지휘자가 군인들에게 차례로 번호를 붙여 말하라는 구령.
ko: 소대장이 “번호!” 구령을 내리자 군인들은 차례대로 번호를 외치기 시작했다.
en_current: When the platoon leader called out 'Roll call!' the soldiers began calling out their numbers in turn.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Military command 번호! means "Count off!", not "Roll call!"
flags.suggested: When the platoon leader called out 'Count off!' the soldiers began calling out their numbers in turn.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: Military command 번호! means "Count off!", not "Roll call!"
flags.suggested: Count off!

ko_def: 독하고 무서운 기운이나 분위기.
ko: 평생 많은 역경을 혼자서 헤쳐 온 그의 눈에는 어떤 살기가 어려 있었다.
en_current: In the eyes of a man who had weathered many hardships alone all his life, a menacing look lingered.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Replaces 그 ("his eyes") with indefinite "a man"
flags.suggested: In his eyes, having weathered many hardships alone all his life, a menacing look lingered.

ko_def: 도망하는 사람을 따라가며 쫓음.
ko: 범인은 형사의 추적을 피하기 위해 일부러 전국 곳곳을 돌아다니며 몸을 숨겼다.
en_current: To evade the detective's pursuit, the culprit deliberately wandered all over the country and hid himself.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Invents male gender ("himself") for 범인 (culprit of unstated sex)
flags.suggested: To evade the detective's pursuit, the culprit deliberately wandered all over the country and hid.

ko_def: 논과 밭 등이 많은 한적한 시골.
ko: 할아버지께서는 전원에 사시면서 깨끗한 공기와 상쾌한 바람을 누리셨다.
en_current: Grandfather lives in the countryside and enjoys clean air and refreshing breezes.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Past tense 누리셨다 mistranslated as present tense ("lives... enjoys")
flags.suggested: Grandfather lived in the countryside and enjoyed clean air and refreshing breezes.

ko_def: 남이 알아차리지 못하게 천천히 조용하게 행동하는 모양.
ko: 김 과장은 급한 일이 생겨서 회의 도중에 슬슬 자리를 떠야 했다.
en_current: Manager Kim had to quietly slip away from the meeting because an urgent matter came up.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Title 과장 must be "Section Chief", not "Manager"
flags.suggested: Section Chief Kim had to quietly slip away from the meeting because an urgent matter came up.

ko_def: 크고 작은 물결.
ko: 바다에 있던 물고기들이 파란에 휩쓸려 뭍으로 떠내려왔다.
en_current: Fish from the sea were swept away by the turmoil and washed up onto the shore.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 파란 means physical waves (크고 작은 물결), not figurative "turmoil"
flags.suggested: Fish from the sea were swept away by the waves and washed up onto the shore.

ko_def: 낮 열두 시부터 밤 열두 시까지의 시간.
ko: 친구는 하오 일곱 시에 미국으로 가는 비행기를 탔다.
en_current: My friend boarded a plane bound for America at seven in the afternoon.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Awkward literal rendering "seven in the afternoon" for 하오 일곱 시
flags.suggested: My friend boarded a plane bound for America at seven in the evening.

ko_def: 지나치게 많음.
ko: 아무리 몸에 좋다는 약도 과다 복용할 경우 부작용이 나타날 수 있다.
en_current: No matter how good a medicine is said to be for the body, excessive dosage can cause side effects.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "extreme" is misleading for 과다 (excessive quantity)
flags.suggested: excess; excessive; over-

ko_def: (높이는 말로) 스승의 남편.
ko: 국어 선생님의 사부님 역시 국어를 전공하신 선생님이셨다.
en_current: The Korean language teacher's own master teacher was also a teacher who had majored in Korean.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 사부님 means teacher's husband (스승의 남편), not "master teacher"
flags.suggested: The Korean language teacher's husband was also a teacher who had majored in Korean.

ko_def: 싸우려고 하는 마음이나 의지.
ko: 장군은 폐허가 된 마을을 보고 적을 향해 전의를 불태웠다.
en_current: Seeing the ruined village, the general fired up their troops' fighting spirit against the enemy.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Adds "their troops'"; general burned with his own fighting spirit
flags.suggested: Seeing the ruined village, the general burned with fighting spirit against the enemy.

ko_def: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 어린아이.
ko: 삼촌은 그 꼬맹이가 귀엽다는 듯이 볼을 가볍게 꼬집었다.
en_current: Uncle lightly pinched the little rascal's cheek, as if he found him adorable.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Invents male gender ("him") for 그 꼬맹이 (child of unstated sex)
flags.suggested: Uncle lightly pinched the little rascal's cheek, as if he found them adorable.

ko_def: 조금 더 먼저. 또는 그때 이미.
ko: 진작에 알았으면 이 고생을 안 했을 텐데.
en_current: If I had known long ago, I wouldn't have had to go through all this trouble.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: 진작에 means earlier/sooner (조금 더 먼저), not "long ago"
flags.suggested: If I had known earlier, I wouldn't have had to go through all this trouble.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "long ago" misrenders 진작에 (earlier/sooner)
flags.suggested: earlier; sooner; beforehand

ko_def: 환자가 위험한 상황을 넘기게 하다.
ko: 아이가 열이 내리자 병세를 돌렸다.
en_current: When the child's fever came down, the illness turned around.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: 아이가 병세를 돌렸다 means child turned the corner, not the illness
flags.suggested: When the child's fever came down, they turned the corner.

ko_def: 한 사람. 또는 어떤 사람.
ko: 하루는 일인이 승규를 찾아갔다.
en_current: One day, one man went to find Seung-gyu.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Invents male gender ("one man") for 일인 (one person)
flags.suggested: One day, someone went to see Seung-gyu.

ko_def: 죄를 지은 사람을 가두어 두고 관리하는 시설.
ko: 김 씨는 도둑질을 하다가 잡혀 몇 년 동안 교도소에 있었다.
en_current: Mr. Kim was caught stealing and spent several years in prison.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Invents male gender ("Mr.") for 김 씨 (unisex surname)
flags.suggested: Kim was caught stealing and spent several years in prison.

ko_def: 정신이 나간 것처럼 멍한 상태로 있다.
ko: 민준이는 수업 시간 내내 멍청한 표정으로 가만히 앉아만 있었다.
en_current: Minjun sat quietly all through class with a stunned expression.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 멍청하다 (멍한 상태로 있다) means vacant/blank, not "stunned"
flags.suggested: Minjun sat quietly all through class with a blank expression.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "stunned; numbed" misrenders 멍청하다 (blank/vacant)
flags.suggested: blank; vacant; dazed

ko_def: 남이 절대로 알아서는 안 되는 아주 중요한 비밀.
ko: 김 부장은 회사 경영 기밀을 유출한 혐의로 구속되었다.
en_current: Director Kim was arrested on suspicion of leaking the company's top-secret management information.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Title 부장 must be "Department Head", not "Director"
flags.suggested: Department Head Kim was arrested on suspicion of leaking the company's top-secret management information.

ko_def: 군대에서 원사의 아래, 중사의 위인 계급. 또는 그 계급인 군인.
ko: 상사는 병사들을 불러 지시 사항을 전달했다.
en_current: The sergeant called the soldiers over and passed on their instructions.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Rank 상사 is "master sergeant" or "first sergeant", not generic "sergeant"
flags.suggested: The master sergeant called the soldiers over and passed on their instructions.

ko_def: 사람에게 해를 끼치는 귀신.
ko: 용맹한 사람이 사람들을 괴롭히던 요괴를 잡아 영웅이 되었다.
en_current: A brave man captured the monster that had been tormenting people and became a hero.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Invents male gender ("man") for 용맹한 사람 (person of unstated sex)
flags.suggested: A brave person captured the monster that had been tormenting people and became a hero.

ko_def: 다른 사람과 어떤 일을 함께 하면서 시간을 보내다.
ko: 유민이는 전쟁터에서 나와 생사를 함께한 친구이다.
en_current: Yumin is a friend with whom I came out of the battlefield, sharing life and death.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: Misreads 나와 ("with me") as verb "came out of"
flags.suggested: Yumin is a friend who shared life and death with me on the battlefield.

ko_def: 도둑이나 재난으로부터 보호하기 위해 돈, 보석, 중요한 서류 등 귀중한 물건을 보관하는 데 사용하는 상자나 창고.
ko: 도둑이 금고에 있던 현금을 모두 훔쳐 갔다.
en_current: The thief stole all the cash that had been in the safe.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: "safety" is wrong for 금고 (safe/strongbox)
flags.suggested: safe; strongbox; finance company; credit cooperative; credit union

ko_def: (욕하는 말로) 듣는 사람이 남자일 때, 그 사람을 가리키는 말.
ko: 평소에 욕을 잘했던 아버지는 나를 항상 네놈이라고 불렀다.
en_current: My father, who often swore, always called me that fellow.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 네놈 is second-person derogatory ("you bastard"), not "that fellow"
flags.suggested: My father, who often swore, always called me 'you bastard.'

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: 네놈 is second-person derogatory pronoun, not third-person "this man"
flags.suggested: you bastard; you punk; you wretch

ko_def: (비유적으로) 확실하게 결말을 내지 않고 잠시 감추거나 흐지부지 덮어 버림.
ko: 언론은 거짓 호도를 하여 국민을 혼란에 빠뜨렸다.
en_current: The media engaged in false distortion, plunging the public into confusion.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 호도 means glossing over/covering up, not "distortion"
flags.suggested: The media glossed things over with falsehoods, plunging the public into confusion.

ko_def: 셀로판과 같은 엷은 막.
ko: 다행히 필름이 있어서 긁힌 자국이 남지 않았다.
en_current: Fortunately, there was a protective film, so no scratch marks were left behind.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: 뜻 is slang for drunken memory blackout, not film
flags.suggested: blackout (memory loss from drinking); (also: photographic film)

ko_def: 총알에 맞아 생긴 상처.
ko: 김 씨는 총격전에서 심한 총상을 입고 죽게 되었다.
en_current: Mr. Kim suffered a severe gunshot wound in the shootout and nearly died.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 죽게 되었다 means died, not nearly died
flags.suggested: Mr. Kim suffered a severe gunshot wound in the shootout and died.

ko_def: 범죄를 저질렀을 가능성이 있다는 의심을 받음.
ko: 그 연예인은 끝까지 자신의 피의 사실을 부인했다.
en_current: That entertainer denied the allegations against him to the very end.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Gender "him" invented for entertainer
flags.suggested: That entertainer denied the allegations against them to the very end.

ko_def: (옛날에) 물건처럼 사고팔리어 남이 시키는 대로 일을 하는 사람.
ko: 그는 돈을 주고 노예를 사 와서 그에게 온갖 일을 다 시켰다.
en_current: He paid money to buy a slave and made him do every kind of work.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: Gender "him" invented for the slave
flags.suggested: He paid money to buy a slave and made them do every kind of work.

ko_def: (놀리는 말로) 살이 쪄서 뚱뚱한 사람.
ko: 한 뚱보가 살을 빼려고 헬스장에서 운동 중이다.
en_current: A chubby guy is working out at the gym to lose weight.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: "guy" invents male gender; 뚱보 is a person, not "chubby guy"
flags.suggested: A fat person is working out at the gym to lose weight.

ko_def: 배나 가슴으로 깊게 숨을 쉼.
ko: 김 부장은 심호흡을 한 번 한 뒤 조심스럽게 사장실 문을 노크했다.
en_current: Director Kim took a deep breath and then cautiously knocked on the president's office door.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: 부장 is department head, not "Director"
flags.suggested: Department Head Kim took a deep breath and then cautiously knocked on the president's office door.

gloss_current: to the utmost; as much as one can
ko_def: 힘이나 정도가 미치는 데까지 최대한.
ko: 기껏 차려입고 나갔는데 소나기가 쏟아져 온몸이 다 젖어 버렸다.
en_current: I dressed up as best I could and went out, but a sudden shower poured down and soaked me through.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 기껏 here means "after going to the trouble", not "as best I could"
flags.suggested: I went to all the trouble of dressing up and headed out, but a sudden shower soaked me through.

ko_def: 끝이 없을 정도로 매우 많음.
ko: 승규는 생각보다 문제가 어려워 시험 보는 내내 무진장으로 애를 먹었다.
en_current: The problems were harder than Seung-gyu had expected, and he struggled with the sheer number of them throughout the entire test.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 애를 먹다 = had a hard time; not struggling with the number of problems
flags.suggested: The problems were harder than Seung-gyu had expected, so he had an extremely hard time throughout the test.

ko_def: 테니스, 탁구, 농구, 배구 등에서 공이 일정한 선 밖으로 나가는 일.
ko: 나는 공을 차는 족족 아웃이 되어 짜증이 났다.
en_current: Every time I kicked the ball, I was called out, which annoyed me.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: The kicked ball goes out of bounds; no one is "called out"
flags.suggested: Every time I kicked the ball, it went out of bounds, which annoyed me.

ko_def: 너그러운 마음으로 다른 사람의 말이나 생각, 행동 또는 물건이나 상황 등을 받아들임.
ko: 김 사장은 작은 실수도 용납 못 하는 사람이다.
en_current: Mr. Kim is the type of person who cannot tolerate even the smallest mistake.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 사장 (company president) title dropped as "Mr."
flags.suggested: President Kim is someone who cannot tolerate even the smallest mistake.

ko_def: 은행에서, 돈을 보내는 사람을 대신하여 단체나 회사 등의 예금 계좌에 돈을 보내 주는 방법.
ko: 승규는 이번 달 전기 요금을 지로로 납부하였다.
en_current: Seung-gyu paid this month's electricity bill through giro.

flags.label: GLOSS
flags.reason: 지로 is a bank giro payment, not electronic billing
flags.suggested: giro (bank giro payment)

gloss_current: The right time for obtaining a good result.
ko_def: 좋은 결과를 얻기 위한 적절한 시기.
ko: 김 사장은 새로운 사업에 뛰어들 타이밍을 기다리고 있다.
en_current: Mr. Kim is waiting for the right timing to jump into the new business.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 사장 (company president) title dropped as "Mr."
flags.suggested: President Kim is waiting for the right timing to jump into the new business.

ko_def: 물건이나 건물, 땅 등을 남에게 빌려줌.
ko: 앞집 아주머니는 빌딩 두 채를 가지고 임대 사업을 해서 큰돈을 벌었다.
en_current: The lady next door owns two office buildings and earned a lot of money through the rental business.

flags.label: MINOR
flags.reason: "office" added; Korean says only buildings
flags.suggested: The lady across the way owns two buildings and earned a lot of money through the rental business.

ko_def: 매우 조심스럽게.
ko: 김 사장은 새로운 사업 분야에 진출할지 여부를 신중히 검토하고 있다.
en_current: Mr. Kim is carefully considering whether to enter a new business field.

flags.label: MAJOR
flags.reason: 사장 (company president) title dropped as "Mr."
flags.suggested: President Kim is carefully considering whether to enter a new business field.
